Annieville homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Annieville, October 2026. Detached houses: 46 listed at month end and 8 sold in October, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 15 listed at month end and 1 sold in October, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 25 sold over 5 months against an average of 52.8 listed, about 10.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 8 sold. Condos and townhomes: 8 sold over 5 months against an average of 15.8 listed, about 9.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 3 sold.

faq.q: How do buses connect Annieville to SkyTrain?
faq.a: Routes 312 and 391 both terminate at Scott Road Station on the Expo Line — the 312 runs via 112 Street and the 391 via 116 Street.
George Mackie Library, a Fraser Valley Regional Library branch, is at 8440 112th Street, Delta, just east of Annieville in Nordel.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Annieville?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 46 houses listed with 8 sold in the month and 15 condos and townhomes listed with 1 sold in the month in Annieville. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Annieville a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 17%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 7%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
